dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Ray Lake Area (NTS 84D/NW) (GIS data, line features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the line features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 557, Surficial Geology of the Ray Lake Area (NTS 84D/NW).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Ray Lake Area (NTS 84D/NW) (GIS data, line features)
